review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Lead
review_candidates.description: Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to coordinate delivery across a mixed team of engineers and other Project Managers working on on-premise Microsoft infrastructure projects for our clients. This is a coordination and delivery-tracking role rather than a line-management role: the postholder does not manage the performance of the engineers or PMs involved, does not provide technical sign-off or design oversight, and does not hold budget ownership. Line management, technical governance, and budget control for the team and its projects sit with other functions. The role exists to keep a multi-workstream programme moving: sequencing work across engineers and PMs, tracking progress and dependencies, surfacing risks and blockers, and keeping stakeholders informed — while relying on genuine technical familiarity with Microsoft infrastructure to ask the right questions and understand what the team is telling you. Key Responsibilities • Programme coordination: Sequence and coordinate work across a mixed team of engineers and Project Managers assigned to the programme, ensuring dependencies between workstreams are understood and managed. • Delivery tracking: Track progress against plan across all workstreams: milestones, task status, and dependencies, using the team's standard tooling. • Project delivery: Run project deliverables through to closure (scope, plan, resourcing, RAID log, client communications) for the workstreams directly assigned to this role. • Scoping and estimation input: Translate customer requirements into project plans and resource/effort estimates for on-premise infrastructure change (server refreshes, migrations, upgrades, rebuilds, DR), for review and sign-off by technical and budget owners. • Risk and issue escalation: Identify and surface project and programme-level risks and blockers early, and escalate to the appropriate technical, budget, or line-management owner for resolution. • Cross-functional coordination: Coordinate onboarding, offboarding, and interface with pre-sales, service delivery, and support teams to ensure a smooth handover in both directions. • Governance and reporting: Chair progress and status meetings, and produce status reporting (RAG, milestones) for clients and internal stakeholders. • Process ownership: Ensure projects follow agreed methodology (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile, or in-house framework) and contribute to continuous improvement of PMO process, templates, and standards. Technical Skills and Experience Required • Strong working knowledge of core Microsoft infrastructure technologies, sufficient to understand what engineers and other PMs are reporting and ask informed questions — not to provide technical sign-off. This should include most of: • Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy • Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualisation, including host clustering and platform-to-platform migrations • System Center suite (SCVMM, SCCM/MECM) and Windows Server Failover Clustering • On-premise storage technologies (Storage Spaces Direct, SAN/NAS) and on-premise backup and DR platforms • Networking fundamentals and virtualised networking (VLANs, NIC teaming, load balancing) • Delivery experience: Track record of delivering infrastructure projects (migrations, server refreshes, datacentre moves, DR builds) from initiation through to closure. • Methodology: Formal project management certification (PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, or equivalent) and familiarity with Agile/hybrid delivery approaches. • MSP experience: Experience operating in an MSP or multi-client environment, managing competing priorities and client-specific governance requirements • Stakeholder management: Confident communicating with senior stakeholders, both client-side and internal, including surfacing issues clearly and promptly. • Technical literacy: Able to follow a technical discussion and ask the right questions, even outside your own specialism, without needing to make the technical call yourself. Desirable Skills & Experience • Microsoft certifications (e.g. Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, MCSE-era Server/AD credentials) or equivalent hands-on infrastructure background. • Experience with PSA/PPM tooling (e.g Microsoft Project, Microsoft Planner) for portfolio and resource management. • Exposure to Citrix, NetScaler, or other application/desktop virtualisation projects.

This is a technical role that not only develops and implements security solutions but uses the solutions to combat malicious cyber attacks while satisfying FedRAMP compliance requirements. Preferred Qualifications Deep practical understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, threat models, and regulatory frameworks (specifically NIST SP 800-53 and FedRAMP Moderate/High standards) and supporting continuous monitoring in FedRAMP environments. Direct experience building and maintaining custom Splunk applications Proven ability to translate non-technical business and regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions. review_candidates.title: Lead Cyber Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: About AC3 At AC3, our purpose is simple: make technology real. We help Australian organisations turn complex technology into secure, reliable and practical outcomes across managed services, professional services, cloud, networking and cyber security. We are practical, customer-focused and grounded in the AC3 Way: Work Wise, Work Humble and Work Honest. The opportunity We are looking for a deeply technical Cyber Security Engineering Lead to sit at the frontline of AC3's Cyber Security Operations Centre and lead the engineering capability behind our managed security services. This is a technical leadership role first. You do not need to have held a formal people-leader title before. You may be an experienced Level 3 engineer or lead engineer who is already the person others turn to for difficult problems, implementation decisions, quality assurance and technical guidance. AC3 can mentor the right person through the formal people-leadership component. What cannot be taught quickly is the technical depth: you will need strong hands-on security engineering capability, prior MSP or MSSP experience, and a track record of leading customer implementation and deployment projects as the senior or lead engineer. What you will be doing Act as the senior Level 3 escalation point for complex engineering issues across AC3's managed security platform estate. Design, implement, deploy, configure and enhance security platforms for new and existing customers Lead technical delivery across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, upgrade and deployment projects from discovery through to operational handover Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across security technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Carbon Black, Zscaler, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender, Azure and AWS Produce high-quality technical artefacts including high-level and low-level designs, as-built documentation, configuration records, runbooks, procedures and support handover material. Own technical quality across engineering work, including peer review, implementation standards and readiness for transition into managed operations. Drive patching, vulnerability management and lifecycle uplift across managed security platforms in line with policy and customer SLAs. Lead the onboarding of new security services and work closely with customers, the SOC Manager, analysts, engineers and internal stakeholders to keep delivery moving. Create and maintain SOPs and runbooks used by analysts and engineers for operational support and incident response. Identify opportunities for automation, platform improvement and stronger repeatable engineering practices across the CSOC. Train, coach and technically mentor junior engineers, helping them build troubleshooting, implementation and customer-facing capability. Support work planning, technical prioritisation and team leadership activities, with mentoring available as you grow into any formal people-management responsibilities. What you will bring Strong Level 3 cyber security engineering experience across enterprise or managed customer environments. Previous experience working for an MSP, MSSP, systems integrator or consultancy supporting multiple customers - this is essential. Demonstrated experience leading security implementation and deployment projects as the senior or lead engineer, including planning, design, build, testing, customer engagement and handover. Hands-on experience implementing and supporting security products used by a SOC or managed security service. Broad technical capability across several technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Carbon Black, Zscaler, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender, Azure and AWS. Strong understanding of systems, infrastructure, SaaS, networks, private cloud, public cloud and the dependencies that underpin modern security environments. The ability to investigate difficult technical issues, establish root cause, assess risk and drive practical resolution under pressure. Strong knowledge of vulnerability management, security platform patching and operational lifecycle management. Experience producing detailed high-level and low-level designs and implementation documentation for enterprise environments. A customer-focused communication style and the confidence to lead technical discussions with engineers, project teams and customer stakeholders. The ability and willingness to train, coach and raise the technical capability of less experienced engineers. Australian citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance at Baseline level or above. People leadership experience is not the gate Prior formal people-management experience is welcome, but it is not essential. We are more interested in a credible technical leader who sets standards, supports others, handles escalations and can be developed into the broader people-leadership responsibilities of the role. You should, however, be comfortable giving technical direction, reviewing work, identifying capability gaps and coaching junior team members. This is not an individual-contributor role with a lead title attached. Highly regarded Recent cyber security operations experience across enterprise, corporate or government customers. Experience with security compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, the ACSC ISM or SOC 2. Automation or scripting capability using Python, PowerShell, Ruby or similar tools. Vendor certifications across Microsoft/Azure, Splunk, Rapid7, Palo Alto, Zscaler, AWS, Qualys, Tenable, F5 or related security platforms. Broader security certifications such as CISSP, OSCE or equivalent. Experience supporting presales, technical discovery, estimates, solution design or Statements of Work. Why this role is worth a look $140,000-$160,000 base + super + 5% variable remuneration. The role remains genuinely hands-on: you will lead engineering delivery, not just sit in meetings and forward escalations. You will shape the technical standards, deployment quality and operational maturity of AC3's managed security platforms. You can move into formal people leadership without needing to pretend you already know every part of it - AC3 will mentor the right technical leader. You will work across multiple customers, environments and technologies, with meaningful variety and technically complex problems. The AC3 Way We would love for you to experience the AC3 Way: Work Wise - as one AC3, we put our combined skills to work to ensure we do more good, for much less. All in service of our customers and each other. Work Humble - as a team, we bring our authentic selves to the world of tech. It is our down-to-earth, humble nature that makes us unique and easy to work with. Work Honest - we are here to do an honest day's work, individually and as a team. We are constantly looking for opportunities to take the initiative and implement practical solutions. Ready to make technology real? Apply now with your CV. Australian citizenship, Sydney location, prior MSP/MSSP experience and eligibility to obtain an Australian Government security clearance at Baseline level or above are mandatory for this position.

review_candidates.description: About ThredUp ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry. Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022. How You Will Make An Impact As a Senior Engineer, Infrastructure, you will design, build, and evolve the core infrastructure that powers ThredUP, with a particular focus on the reliability, performance, and operability of our database estate. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you’ll lead cross-team initiatives and partner with stakeholders to ensure our systems are scalable, cost-effective, and secure. This is an infrastructure-first role for an engineer who is equally comfortable owning production AWS Aurora (MySQL, PostgreSQL). You’ll spend most of your time on cloud-native infrastructure, orchestration, and automation, while serving as the team’s go-to person for database operations, performance tuning, and safe schema evolution. You will play a key role in defining our technical direction and ensuring our platform enables the rapid growth of our marketplace. In This Role You'll Get To Scope & Impact Lead or significantly contribute to medium-to-large infrastructure projects crossing multiple engineering teams. Serve as a domain expert in cloud infrastructure, orchestration, observability, and platform automation, and as the team’s primary owner of database reliability and performance. Ensure ThredUP’s infrastructure evolves to support scale, resilience, and developer productivity. Technical Execution Architect and implement highly available, secure, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure using AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), and Terraform. Drive improvements in CI/CD, observability, networking, and security across the platform. Provide high-quality, impactful technical contributions across infrastructure projects, setting engineering standards. Participate in and lead design reviews, providing constructive feedback and driving engineering excellence. Database Engineering Operate, monitor, and tune AWS Aurora and RDS clusters (MySQL and PostgreSQL), including parameter groups, maintenance, minor/major upgrades, and point-in-time restores. Own HA and replication behavior: respond to failovers, work with cluster vs. instance endpoints, and run the checks required before promoting a reader to writer. Triage and resolve CPU/IO/locking/replication incidents; analyze slow query logs and EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans to produce immediate mitigations and long-term fixes. Plan and execute zero-downtime schema changes with safe rollback paths (online DDL, gh-ost / pt-online-schema-change, pg_repack, logical replication, trigger-based backfills). Partner with application teams to remove N+1 queries, tune indexes, and rewrite inefficient predicates; design partitioning and retention for high-write tables. Design, execute, and regularly validate backup and disaster-recovery procedures. Ownership Act as an expert in infrastructure design, performance, and operations across multiple systems and services. Promote shared ownership of infrastructure by driving documentation, tooling, and process improvements. Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring reliability while protecting teams from burnout. Leadership & Collaboration Build relationships with engineering teams, product managers, and cross-functional partners to ensure infrastructure supports company goals. Contribute to defining strategic technical direction, setting infrastructure roadmaps, and guiding prioritization. Advocate for best practices in reliability, security, and cost management. Ensure knowledge is shared within the team, reducing single points of failure. What We Are Looking For 6+ years of relevant industry experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Hands-on experience operating MySQL and PostgreSQL in production (Aurora/RDS preferred), including indexing strategies, transactions, locking/MVCC, and performance tuning. Demonstrated experience performing zero-downtime schema changes with safe rollbacks. Proven track record of designing and scaling infrastructure for distributed, service-oriented architectures. Expertise in AWS (EKS, RDS, IAM, cost optimization). Proficiency with Kubernetes and Terraform. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD – one or more). Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, or similar), including slow query and error log analysis. Ability to diagnose connectivity issues affecting database access (security groups, VPC routes/TGW, VPN, DNS). Scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar). Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Additional Skills That Are a Plus Experience with Teleport (or similar DB proxying) and IAM DB authentication. Experience tuning Postgres autovacuum and designing partition-based retention policies. Terraform/Terragrunt module design for RDS/Aurora clusters and snapshot restores. Familiarity with service mesh (Istio) and edge/WAF tooling (Cloudflare). Familiarity with data infrastructure (Airflow, Databricks) and messaging/streaming systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, DynamoDB, MongoDB). Knowledge of network security, vulnerability management, and incident response best practices. Experience with Rollbar or centralized logging pipelines. Experience in fintech, testing automation, and/or compliance-heavy environments (GDPR, SOC2). Prior leadership in scaling platforms for e-commerce or high-growth startups. What We Offer Monthly allowance for insurance/education ($200 gross). 50% paid sabbatical after 3 year anniversary. Paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers. IT Kit. We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team At ThredUp, our mission has been built on extending the lives of millions of unique clothing items. Much like our inventory, we are proud to have fostered a workplace that is one-of-a-kind. As a company focused on diversity, inclusion and belonging, we are committed to ensuring our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work every day. A unique perspective is critical to solving complex problems and inspiring a new generation to think secondhand first. Be you.
